parsed.restated: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (S : Set (Fin n → ℝ)), Convex ℝ S → IsCompact S → (interior S).Nonempty → ((MeasureTheory.volume S).toReal)⁻¹ • (∫ x in S, x ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin n → ℝ))) = 0 → {z : Fin n → ℤ | (fun i => (z i : ℝ)) ∈ interior S} = {0} → (MeasureTheory.volume S).toReal ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)
parsed.english: For n ≥ 1 and any compact convex S in ℝⁿ with nonempty interior, whose centroid (∫_S x divided by vol(S)) is the origin and whose only interior integer point is 0, the Lebesgue volume of S is at most (n+1)^n / n!.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the bespoke definitions barycenter, interiorLatticePoints, integerPoint, normalizedVolume and sharpConstant into plain Mathlib notions (Lebesgue volume, Bochner integral, interior, integer points).
